title: Compute pure Al and Li VP model parameters at 1023 K
action: Implement the self-consistent variational-parameter procedure for pure Al and Li at 1023 K to determine the exchange–correlation parameter A_v, Ashcroft pseudopotential radius r_c (au), hard‑sphere packing coefficient η, solid‑sphere diameter d (au), density of states at the Fermi level N(E_F), Landau parameter F₁ˢ, and electronic correlation energy E_cor (au), using a Green’s-function approach for N(E_F) and the Mansoori–Canfield hard‑sphere free‑energy minimisation. Report the results in a CSV.
description: CSV with one row per metal (Al, Li) containing the self-consistently determined VP model parameters.
output_schema: element (text), Av (float), rc_au (float), eta (float), d_au (float), N_EF (float), minus_F1s (float), minus_Ecor_au (float). Two rows: 'Al' and 'Li'.

title: Compute concentration‑dependent alloy properties (Ω₀ case)
action: Using the pure‑component parameters from step 0, additive rules for A_v and atomic volume (alloy density from pure metal densities), and the Mansoori–Canfield variational procedure for binary hard‑sphere mixtures, compute concentration‑dependent properties for Li concentrations 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 at%: exchange–correlation parameter A_v, additive atomic volume Ω₀ (in au³), partial packing coefficients η₁ and η₂, electrical resistivity ρₑₗ (in μΩ·cm) using the Faber–Ziman approximation, sound velocity c (m/s) via the Einstein‑phonon model (c = d ω₀ / √2 with d from packing coefficient), and compressibility β (1/Pa) from β = 1/(ρ c²) using the additive alloy density. Report the results in a CSV.
description: CSV with rows for each Li concentration containing the computed alloy properties under the additive atomic volume approximation, including dynamic properties sound velocity and compressibility.
output_schema: Li_at_percent (integer), Av (float), Omega0_au (float), eta1 (float), eta2 (float), resistivity_uohm_cm (float), c_m_s (float), beta_inv_Pa (float). Rows for 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 at% Li.
